generation.explanation: Each ball makes five left-or-right choices, so its landing bin is determined by how many times it turns right. The animation follows all 32 possible paths: their bin counts are 1, 5, 10, 10, 5, 1—the coefficients of the binomial expansion. Use the slider to see how changing the probability of a right turn changes the theoretical distribution.
